name: Glyph Portal
rationale: Clean-room implementation from the component-specs.md behaviour description only; no 21st.dev source was fetched or read, so no MIT attribution is owed (the upstream author is not recorded in the seed). Same treatment as liquid-glass-card.

origin.description: Fraction of the glyph box the scale grows from.

a11y: The cover SVG is aria-hidden and pointer-events:none at all times, so it never intercepts clicks or enters the accessibility tree.
The 'next' content stays in normal DOM order and reading order behind the cover.
Nothing traps focus: focus landing in the content while it is still covered scrolls the track to its end so the focused element is visible.
The glyph is decoration only; it carries no text alternative and none is needed.
